summary: The single prompt given to Opus 5.5 to generate a complete Tron-style game featuring rival bots, custom music, and an automated trailer.

post.originalText:
I gave Opus 5.5 one prompt: "make a Tron game."

It came back with the game, 3 rival bots with personalities, its own music, and this trailer, which it shot itself.

https://t.co/caFfyya8M9 https://t.co/JFZo5l5y7r

                SPACE Jump over a light wall. Recharges in 7s.
